selection: minimum arithmetic mean validation CE over all three seeds; exact ties: earlier epoch, linear before mlp16, constant before step7
failure: abort on any nonfinite loss, gradient, parameter, evaluation, missing candidate or seed; never drop a failed run
stop: all runs complete 20 epochs; no adaptive early stopping or hyperparameter changes
test_policy: no test tensor indexing, scoring or endpoint selection; old test is already exposed
scope: development validation comparison on reused split, not unbiased generalization evidence
